meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 它把你的 claude-mem 观察记录按项目、类型、概念等条件筛选成一份知识库语料,加载进 AI 会话后,你可以像聊天一样向它提问,回答都基于这份语料。
howto.when: 当你想从历史观察记录里搭一个聚焦的知识库、就过往工作模式提问,或整理某主题的经验时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个 hooks-expertise 语料库,只收 hooks 概念的观察
say.note: 会返回筛出的观察条数

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 语料库加载进会话
say.note: 加载完成后就能开始提问

say.text: 问 hooks-expertise:5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发?
say.note: 回答基于该语料库,可继续追问

howto.what_en: It filters your claude-mem observations by project, type, concept and other criteria into a knowledge corpus, loads that corpus into an AI session, and then answers your questions conversationally from it.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to build a focused knowledge base from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a corpus named hooks-expertise from observations tagged hooks

say_en.note: Loads the corpus into an AI session

say_en.text: Ask hooks-expertise: what are the 5 lifecycle hooks and when does each fire?
say_en.note: Answers come from that corpus; follow-ups keep context
